from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker=min(counts,key=counts.get)
    target=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
    # Use the marker cells as a translation-only template.
    pts0=[(r-min(r for r,c in pts),c-min(c for r,c in pts)) for r,c in pts]
    mh=max(r for r,c in pts0)+1; mw=max(c for r,c in pts0)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-mh+1):
        for c in range(w-mw+1):
            cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in pts0]
            if all(grid[i][j]==target for i,j in cells):
                for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=marker
    return out
pred=transform(A)
print('matches demo',pred==B, sum(pred[r][c]!=B[r][c] for r in range(26) for c in range(27)))
print('demo counts',Counter(v for row in A for v in row))

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    target = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    mh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    mw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - mh + 1):
        for c in range(w - mw + 1):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[i][j] == target for i, j in cells):
                for i, j in cells:
                    out[i][j] = marker
    return out
'''
